sophie: Quick Q — for /v1/generate, what's the intended behavior when X-Project is missing but X-Org is present? Code review flagged inconsistent handling. cc @liam @jeff

liam: Today we sometimes accept org-scoped keys as a fallback if we can unambiguously infer the project. That's implicit right now, which is annoying. Should we make a clear rule?

raj: My preference: be strict. Return 403 when project header missing unless token claims explicitly map to a single project or an admin-marked rotation window applies. 401 should be reserved for invalid/expired creds.

jeff: Agreed on 401 vs 403 distinction. 401 = auth failure (bad token/expired). 403 = authenticated but lacking the right project context/permission. Document it.

auth-bot: Policy note: token scopes: org_key => scopes:org_read,org_admin; project_key => scopes:project_read,project_write. Allowed inference: only when token claims include a single_project_id or org->projects map size == 1.

mira: Implementation note: current middleware attempts inference via X-User + X-Org which is risky. I'll update to only infer from token claims (JWT) or explicit X-Project.

liam: Rotation question: during key rotation grace (we discussed a 7-day window), do we allow org->project fallback for requests missing X-Project? Seems like that increases exposure.

raj: Compromise: allow an "eager fallback" only if request includes an X-Rotation-Token header signed by an admin and timestamp < rotation_window (e.g., 30m). Otherwise 403. That keeps rotation practical but auditable.

sophie: OK. Proposed API contract updates:
1) 401 => invalid/expired credentials (token signature, expiry)
2) 403 => authenticated but missing project context or insufficient scope
3) 404 => resource not found (keep as-is)

I'll open a PR to update the spec and tests. Please review. cc @mira @liam

jeff: :thumbsup: include unit tests for middleware and an integration test covering rotation fallback and audit logging.

mira: I'll take the middleware PR review and the tests. ETA: today EOD.

auth-bot: Doc link updated: /v1/generate auth section now reflects fallback rules — https://go/internal/docs/auth-fallbacks (log id: 6742)

sophie: Thanks — I'll push the PR in ~30m and add the tests.
